title: About us
description: Who builds AstroWind, how it is made and what it is for.

props.title: About us
props.subtitle: We build the starting point we wished we had: a template that survives contact with real content, real translations and real deadlines.

props.title: Our values
props.subtitle: What we optimise for when the two options both look reasonable.

items.title: Clarity over cleverness
items.description: A component someone can read in a minute beats one that saves five lines.

items.title: Defaults that hold
items.description: The out-of-the-box result should be good enough to ship, not a starting point you must fix.

items.title: No hidden costs
items.description: No tracking, no phoning home, no runtime you did not ask for.

items.title: Most forked Astro theme
items.description: Four years running, which says more about the community than about us.

items.title: Zero JavaScript by default
items.description: Every page ships as HTML and CSS unless you explicitly opt into an island.

items.title: Accessible by construction
items.description: Focus states, landmarks and contrast are part of the components, not an afterthought.

props.title: How we work
props.subtitle: The loop we repeat, release after release.

items.title: Build something real
items.description: Every feature starts as a page we actually need, not as an abstraction we imagine someone will want.

items.title: Find where it breaks
items.description: We keep a backlog of the limits real pages hit. Nothing speculative goes in it.

items.title: Fix the cause
items.description: Then we fix the framework rather than working around it in the page.

items.title: GitHub
items.description: Issues, discussions and pull requests. The fastest route to a maintainer.

items.title: Email
items.description: For anything that does not belong in public. We answer within two working days.

items.title: Community
items.description: Ask questions and share what you have built with other people using the template.
